jobs.title: Senior AI Agent Platform Engineer (.NET/Python)
jobs.description:
Senior AI Agent Developer / AI Platform Engineer (.NET/Python)

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced AI Agent Developer / AI Platform Engineer to design, develop, and deploy sophisticated AI agents and multi-agent solutions within an enterprise Microsoft Azure environment.

This role is focused on hands-on, pro-code AI engineering using C#/.NET and/or Python, Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure OpenAI. The ideal candidate will have experience building production-grade AI agents, orchestrating complex workflows, integrating enterprise systems, and developing reusable components that support scalable AI adoption.
This is a highly technical, hands-on engineering position requiring strong software development fundamentals, practical experience with agentic AI architectures, and the ability to build secure, reliable AI solutions within an enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade AI agents and multi-agent applications using Microsoft Agent Framework and C#/.NET and/or Python.
Build sophisticated agentic workflows incorporating tool calling, state management, contextual memory, middleware, and multi-agent orchestration.
Develop graph-based workflows supporting complex business processes, long-running operations, and human-in-the-loop interactions.
Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, APIs, external tools, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
Design, develop, secure, and maintain MCP servers to enable controlled access to enterprise systems and data.
Leverage Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI to integrate large language models (LLMs) into enterprise applications, including support for additional hosted models.
Configure and manage Azure API Management (APIM) as an AI gateway, including API routing, authentication, token management, policies, and logging.
Implement secure agent authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, and enterprise identity platforms such as Okta.
Develop reusable agent components, shared services, and engineering patterns to support multiple AI development teams.
Deploy and maintain AI applications using Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, and other Azure-native services.
Implement telemetry, observability, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI safeguards to ensure reliability, performance, and security.
Support automated deployments, infrastructure as code (IaC), and CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub.
Collaborate with solution architects, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable AI solutions.

Required Qualifications

Strong professional software engineering experience with C#/.NET and/or Python, including backend application development, API integrations, and enterprise software architecture.
Hands-on experience developing AI agents using Microsoft Agent Framework, including tool integration, agent state, memory/context management, and workflow orchestration.
Experience designing and implementing multi-agent systems, including agent-to-agent coordination, graph-based workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes.
Strong understanding of LLM integration, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and agentic AI design patterns.
Practical experience with Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI, including model integration and deployment.
Experience working with Model Context Protocol (MCP), including building, integrating, and securing MCP servers.
Knowledge of Azure API Management (APIM), particularly AI gateway functionality, routing, policies, authentication, and monitoring.
Experience implementing enterprise identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID, app registrations, managed identities, and/or Okta.
Familiarity with Azure-native application services, including Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, and Azure AI Search.
Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and modern DevOps practices.
Understanding of AI application observability, telemetry, evaluation, security, and responsible AI principles.
Ability to independently design, troubleshoot, and deliver complex technical solutions while contributing to shared engineering standards.

Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience with Microsoft Semantic Kernel or AutoGen, including migration or transition to Microsoft Agent Framework.
Experience integrating Microsoft Copilot Studio with custom-developed, pro-code AI agents.
Familiarity with Azure landing-zone architecture, cloud networking, and enterprise security controls.
Experience with Okta integrations for AI agents, including agent identity governance and discovery.
Experience building AI solutions in regulated industries, particularly healthcare, with awareness of HIPAA and sensitive-data protection requirements.
Experience developing reusable AI frameworks, shared agent components, and enterprise engineering standards.
Proven ability to deliver technical solutions within structured development cycles and clearly defined acceptance criteria.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on software engineer who has moved beyond basic LLM integrations, chatbots, or low-code automation and has practical experience building custom AI agents and complex, production-ready agentic systems.

We are particularly interested in engineers who understand the underlying architecture of agent orchestration, can develop and secure custom MCP integrations, and have experience deploying AI applications into enterprise Azure environments.

This individual should be comfortable solving complex engineering challenges, contributing to reusable platform capabilities, and working collaboratively across technical and business teams.
This is a hands-on development role, not a prompt engineering, data science, or low-code AI configuration position.

About the Company

PrizePicks is a sports entertainment company recognized by Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing sports companies in North America. Its Daily Fantasy Sports (DFS) platform covers a range of sports leagues, including the NFL and NBA, as well as esports titles such as League of Legends and Counter-Strike.

With a team of more than 550 employees, PrizePicks promotes an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom.

About the Role

PrizePicks is seeking an experienced leader to oversee line-setting strategy, projection accuracy, and market expansion across its fantasy sports offerings. In this role, you will lead a team of data scientists and analysts responsible for creating markets and originating player props across major sports and esports.

You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Pricing, and Business Operations teams to launch new markets, improve projection models, and expand coverage. The role combines data science, statistical modeling, team leadership, and market strategy, with a focus on maintaining accurate projections, reliable data, and a strong overall market offering.

Key Responsibilities

Own line-setting strategy and projection accuracy across fantasy markets, balancing market coverage with competitive line quality.
Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing team of data scientists and analysts focused on market creation and prop origination.
Oversee the development and deployment of projection models and the expansion of coverage across major sports and esports, including the NBA, NFL, MLB, and CS2.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Pricing, and Business Operations teams to launch new markets and broaden coverage.
Guide experimentation involving line accuracy, prop selection, and coverage strategy to increase engagement and expand the market catalog.
Maintain and improve frameworks for measuring projection accuracy, evaluating coverage quality, and monitoring market health.
Ensure data integrity and modeling quality across all market origination efforts.

Required Qualifications

At least 5 years of experience in sports betting, fantasy sports, or related gaming industries, ideally with exposure to line setting, trading, or player performance modeling.
Strong technical foundation in data science, statistics, or software engineering.
Demonstrated management experience, including leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams.
Proficiency in SQL and Python or R.
Experience with predictive modeling, forecasting, and statistical techniques.
Strong understanding of how player props and sports and esports markets are structured, originated, and modeled.
Proven ability to lead complex projects from initial concept through launch in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work across data, product, and operations teams.
Authorization to work for any employer in the United States. PrizePicks is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.

Our employees' well-being—both physical and mental—is a top priority at VertexOne. That's why we foster a 100% remote and flexible environment and encourage work-life balance.

VertexOne is proudly Certified as a Great Place to Work®. Great Place to Work® is the global authority on workplace culture, employee experience, and leadership behaviors proven to deliver market-leading revenue, employee retention and increased innovation. VertexOne is dedicated to prioritizing the employee experience and creating an exceptional company culture.

Data Analyst II, Data Migration

Job Description

Overview of Role/Job Purpose:

The Data Analyst II, Data Migration is a highly visibility role focused on migrating and onboarding utility customers to VertexOne's CIS platform. Reporting to the Data Migration Manager, this analyst extracts, profiles, maps, transforms, and validates customer data from legacy systems. They ensure data accuracy, conversion stability, and clear exceptions handling through every phase of delivery.

The role combines analytical judgement with practical automation and process improvement. This person will help improve the way we deliver migrations so that each conversion is more repeatable, efficient, and reliable. They will work closely with internal teams and utility clients during discovery, mapping, mock conversions, validation, and go-live.

The successful candidate is deeply data driven, meticulous, and able to communicate complex data issues clearly to both technical and business audiences. They will partner closely with the Data Migration Manager on delivery planning, team direction, and practical AI automation, and act as the manager's delegate when needed. This is a hands-on role for someone who is technology-curious, eager to learn, enjoys solving messy data problems, building practical expertise, and growing into team leadership within the data migration organization.

Essential Duties

Work with clients to extract, profile, and analyze source data from legacy utility CIS, billing, and metering systems, including relational databases, and flat or fixed width files.
Lead day-to-day technical direction for migration engineers, including reviewing and approving mappings, transformation logic, and validation results before they go to clients.
Create and maintain project and team weekly status reports.
Develop and maintain source to target data mappings and transformation logic in partnership with Implementation, Product, and utility client teams.
Write, optimize, and maintain SQL for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, and validation.
Execute mock conversions and production cutovers, validating record counts, balances, and business rules at each migration phase.
Own cutover readiness for assigned client migrations, including runbooks, go/no-go recommendations, and post-migration validation sign-off.
Design and implement data quality checks, reconciliation reports, and exception handling that surface issues early and ensure stability through go live.
Identify manual and repetitive migration tasks and build automated, reusable workflows using KNIME, scripting, and other automation tooling.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of migration methodology, templates, and standards to increase accuracy, efficiency, and repeatability.
Perform root cause analysis on data defects and conversion errors, and drive resolution with internal and client stakeholders.
Own one or more client migration streams end to end and act as interim decision-maker when the Data Migration Manager is unavailable.
Lead data and migration training sessions for clients, explaining utilities CIS data entities and relationships, including functional concepts on how they relate to each other.
Communicate migration status, data quality findings, risks, and readiness clearly to project teams, leadership, and utility clients.
Document mappings, processes, workflows, and lessons learned for internal knowledge sharing.
Uphold data governance, privacy, and security standards for sensitive customer and billing data.

Job Qualifications

4 to 8 years of experience in data analysis, data migration, ETL, or a related technical role.
Experience leading or reviewing the work of other analysts or engineers on data migration or ETL projects.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, aggregations, and data validation queries.
Experience with utility CIS or billing platforms (e.g., SAP IS-U, Oracle CC&B, or similar) and utility meter or billing data.
Demonstrated experience with data mapping, data profiling, and data quality or reconciliation practices.
Experience with ETL or workflow tools (e.g., KNIME, SSIS, Talend, Alteryx, Airflow, Python).
Exceptional attention to detail and a data driven approach to problem solving and decision making.
Ability to manage multiple migration workstreams and deadlines in a fast paced, high visibility environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to business and client audiences.
Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends during production cutovers and go live events.
Coordinate with an offshore delivery team, including regular working-hour overlap.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Hands-on SQL experience with DB2 for IBM i (AS400) or other legacy mainframe data sources.
Experience with KNIME Analytics Platform.
Proficiency in Python or another modern programming language for data processing and automation.
Experience with agentic engineering, including using AI agents and LLM tools to accelerate analysis, mapping, and automation.
Familiarity with automation and orchestration tooling (e.g., Airflow, Bash scripting, CI/CD pipelines) and version control (e.g., Git).
Experience in a SaaS organization.

Personal Attributes

Meticulous: Treats every record as important and holds a high bar for accuracy and completeness.
Data Driven: Relies on evidence, metrics, and validation results to guide decisions and recommendations.
Process Improver: Continuously looks for ways to automate, standardize, and strengthen how work gets done.
Clear Communicator: Conveys status, risks, and findings with clarity and confidence to technical, business, and client audiences.
Composed Under Pressure: Stays steady and focused during cutovers, tight deadlines, and high visibility moments.
Collaborative: Builds trust across Implementation, Product, Engineering, and client teams.
Ownership Minded: Takes accountability for deliverables from mapping through go live.

What VertexOne Has To Offer

Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance
Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSAs)
401K match
Flexible PTO
Employee recognition platform with monetary rewards
100% Remote work environment
Initial work from home stipend
Leadership/Coaching training programs
Free access to Bizlibrary for unlimited professional development
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counseling sessions available 24/7
Health and wellbeing programs
Paid parental leave
Employee bonus referral program
Employee Discount Program

jobs.title: Data Analyst II - Remote
jobs.description:
About the Company

Commence focuses on data-driven transformation in healthcare, combining technology, clinical expertise, and quality data solutions to improve healthcare outcomes and make processes more efficient. The company develops solutions that help healthcare organizations turn clinical and administrative data into actionable insights, supporting better care delivery and operational performance.

With an emphasis on clinical expertise, clear communication, and practical results, Commence works to improve the way healthcare data is managed and used.

About the Role

Commence is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to work across Data, Technology, and Operations teams to analyze complex healthcare datasets, develop analytical models, and generate insights that support internal products, client solutions, and strategic decisions.

In this role, you will help shape how clinical and administrative data are collected, organized, validated, and used across the organization. You will collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and healthcare subject matter experts to develop scalable analytics, maintain data quality, and support informed decision-making. The position also involves guiding junior analysts and contributing to data strategy, governance, and reporting practices.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze large healthcare datasets, including claims, electronic health records (EHR), FHIR data, and registries, to identify trends, outliers, and key performance indicators.
Lead complex analyses of healthcare performance, utilization patterns, and program outcomes across diverse datasets.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and subject matter experts to define data requirements, metrics, and quality controls.
Build and maintain curated datasets, data models, dashboards, and reporting solutions using SQL, Python, or business intelligence tools.
Design and conduct analyses for clinical, operational, and policy-related needs, including cohort definitions, utilization analysis, quality measurement, and risk stratification.
Develop and document business rules for data standardization, mapping, and transformation to support consistent analytics.
Validate data, test pipelines, and perform quality assurance on analytics-ready datasets, identifying anomalies and supporting root cause analysis.
Present analytical findings through clear narratives and data visualizations using Qlik or AWS QuickSight to support technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Monitor data health and performance metrics, support anomaly detection, and identify opportunities to improve data quality.
Contribute to data strategy and architecture decisions through domain-informed analysis, metric modeling, and collaboration with engineering and product teams.
Mentor junior analysts and cross-functional colleagues on data analysis, documentation, and data quality best practices.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Health Informatics, Public Health, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. A master’s degree is preferred.
At least 7 years of experience working with healthcare data, including EHR, claims, registries, or public health datasets.
Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one analytics-oriented programming language, such as Python or R.
Experience building analytical datasets, dashboards, or reporting frameworks using tools such as Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or QuickSight.

Data Analyst II, Data Migration

Job Description

Overview of Role/Job Purpose:

The Data Analyst II, Data Migration is a highly visibility role focused on migrating and onboarding utility customers to VertexOne's CIS platform. Reporting to the Data Migration Manager, this analyst extracts, profiles, maps, transforms, and validates customer data from legacy systems. They ensure data accuracy, conversion stability, and clear exceptions handling through every phase of delivery.

The role combines analytical judgement with practical automation and process improvement. This person will help improve the way we deliver migrations so that each conversion is more repeatable, efficient, and reliable. They will work closely with internal teams and utility clients during discovery, mapping, mock conversions, validation, and go-live.

The successful candidate is deeply data driven, meticulous, and able to communicate complex data issues clearly to both technical and business audiences. They will partner closely with the Data Migration Manager on delivery planning, team direction, and practical AI automation, and act as the manager's delegate when needed. This is a hands-on role for someone who is technology-curious, eager to learn, enjoys solving messy data problems, building practical expertise, and growing into team leadership within the data migration organization.

Essential Duties

Work with clients to extract, profile, and analyze source data from legacy utility CIS, billing, and metering systems, including relational databases, and flat or fixed width files.
Lead day-to-day technical direction for migration engineers, including reviewing and approving mappings, transformation logic, and validation results before they go to clients.
Create and maintain project and team weekly status reports.
Develop and maintain source to target data mappings and transformation logic in partnership with Implementation, Product, and utility client teams.
Write, optimize, and maintain SQL for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, and validation.
Execute mock conversions and production cutovers, validating record counts, balances, and business rules at each migration phase.
Own cutover readiness for assigned client migrations, including runbooks, go/no-go recommendations, and post-migration validation sign-off.
Design and implement data quality checks, reconciliation reports, and exception handling that surface issues early and ensure stability through go live.
Identify manual and repetitive migration tasks and build automated, reusable workflows using KNIME, scripting, and other automation tooling.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of migration methodology, templates, and standards to increase accuracy, efficiency, and repeatability.
Perform root cause analysis on data defects and conversion errors, and drive resolution with internal and client stakeholders.
Own one or more client migration streams end to end and act as interim decision-maker when the Data Migration Manager is unavailable.
Lead data and migration training sessions for clients, explaining utilities CIS data entities and relationships, including functional concepts on how they relate to each other.
Communicate migration status, data quality findings, risks, and readiness clearly to project teams, leadership, and utility clients.
Document mappings, processes, workflows, and lessons learned for internal knowledge sharing.
Uphold data governance, privacy, and security standards for sensitive customer and billing data.

Job Qualifications

4 to 8 years of experience in data analysis, data migration, ETL, or a related technical role.
Experience leading or reviewing the work of other analysts or engineers on data migration or ETL projects.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, aggregations, and data validation queries.

new_jobs.description:
About the Company

Commence focuses on data-driven transformation in healthcare, combining technology, clinical expertise, and quality data solutions to improve healthcare outcomes and make processes more efficient. The company develops solutions that help healthcare organizations turn clinical and administrative data into actionable insights, supporting better care delivery and operational performance.

With an emphasis on clinical expertise, clear communication, and practical results, Commence works to improve the way healthcare data is managed and used.

About the Role

Commence is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to work across Data, Technology, and Operations teams to analyze complex healthcare datasets, develop analytical models, and generate insights that support internal products, client solutions, and strategic decisions.

In this role, you will help shape how clinical and administrative data are collected, organized, validated, and used across the organization. You will collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and healthcare subject matter experts to develop scalable analytics, maintain data quality, and support informed decision-making. The position also involves guiding junior analysts and contributing to data strategy, governance, and reporting practices.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze large healthcare datasets, including claims, electronic health records (EHR), FHIR data, and registries, to identify trends, outliers, and key performance indicators.
Lead complex analyses of healthcare performance, utilization patterns, and program outcomes across diverse datasets.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and subject matter experts to define data requirements, metrics, and quality controls.
Build and maintain curated datasets, data models, dashboards, and reporting solutions using SQL, Python, or business intelligence tools.
Design and conduct analyses for clinical, operational, and policy-related needs, including cohort definitions, utilization analysis, quality measurement, and risk stratification.
Develop and document business rules for data standardization, mapping, and transformation to support consistent analytics.
Validate data, test pipelines, and perform quality assurance on analytics-ready datasets, identifying anomalies and supporting root cause analysis.
Present analytical findings through clear narratives and data visualizations using Qlik or AWS QuickSight to support technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Monitor data health and performance metrics, support anomaly detection, and identify opportunities to improve data quality.
Contribute to data strategy and architecture decisions through domain-informed analysis, metric modeling, and collaboration with engineering and product teams.
Mentor junior analysts and cross-functional colleagues on data analysis, documentation, and data quality best practices.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Health Informatics, Public Health, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. A master’s degree is preferred.
At least 7 years of experience working with healthcare data, including EHR, claims, registries, or public health datasets.
Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one analytics-oriented programming language, such as Python or R.
Experience building analytical datasets, dashboards, or reporting frameworks using tools such as Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or QuickSight.
Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or other modern cloud-based or notebook-based data platforms.
Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as FHIR, HL7, ICD, CPT, and LOINC, along with experience working with healthcare quality or performance measures.
Ability to interpret complex data and communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong data validation, governance, and documentation practices.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills when working across technical and non-technical teams.
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
Experience working in a healthcare or regulated environment.
Experience working in Agile development environments and collaborating with cross-functional product or engineering teams.

Additional Qualifications

Understanding of healthcare-related data governance and security frameworks, such as NIST or HITRUST.
Experience working with government agencies such as CMS, VA, or DoD, or with payer or provider organizations.
Knowledge of healthcare delivery systems, policy frameworks, and value-based care programs.
Experience designing or supporting dashboards and reports for operational, clinical, or executive audiences.
A master’s degree or professional certifications in Data Analytics, Health Informatics, or a related field.

Salary & Benefits

The listed annual salary range is $130,000–$160,000. Additional compensation and benefits details were not specified in the provided job description.

Are you passionate about the patient experience? At HCA Healthcare, we are committed to caring for patients with purpose and integrity. We care like family! Jump-start your career as a Clinical Lab Scientist II today with Good Samaritan Hospital.

Job Summary And Qualifications

Our Clinical Lab Scientists (level II) perform clinical testing in one or more of the following areas: blood bank, chemistry, serology, hematology, urinalysis, coagulation, special chemistry, microbiology and manual tests. Our team is amazing; we consider ourselves a family who work hard to support each other and we are looking for someone who feels patient care is as meaningful as we do. If that is you, come be a part of what makes us great and apply today!

You will perform automated, semi-automated and manual procedures in the fields of bacteriology, parasitology, hematology, coagulation, serology, chemistry, urinalysis, immunology, and immunohematology. According to established procedures and policies
You will perform preventative maintenance on laboratory instrumentation, interpret results as to their accuracy, acceptability and critical limits and organize work to meet established deadlines and record all data obtained
You will work actively and be cooperative with nursing and other hospital staff to ensure timely patient care as well as assist with regulatory compliance
You will be responsible for training lab personnel and are expected to perform in-charge assignment in the absence of a manager

What qualifications you will need:

Valid California State Department of Health Services Clinical Laboratory Scientist License.
Bachelor’s degree in medical technology or equivalent.
In-depth knowledge of the laboratory organization, policies and procedures including technical safety procedures and information system functions.
Supervisory skills in areas of assuming responsibility, exercising independent judgment, making judicious decisions when responding to issues and problems and flexing staff to accommodate workload.
Interpersonal skills necessary to communicate effectively with other healthcare professionals including physicians, hospital staff, laboratory staff, hospital administration and clients.
Analytical skills are necessary to resolve technical and non-technical issues and problems.
Successful completion of a supervised one (1) year clinical laboratory internship.
Minimum five years’ experience as a Clinical Laboratory Scientist.
Ability to learn and utilize computerized patient care management system.
Ability to understand and follow verbal and written instructions. Must effectively read, write and verbally communicate in the English language.

Education support through tuition assistance, student loan assistance, certification support, dependent scholarships and a partnership with Galen College of Nursing
Additional benefits for fertility and family building, adoption assistance, life insurance, supplemental health protection plans, auto and home insurance, legal counseling, identity theft protection and consumer discounts
